verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a customer data platform like Segment, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents a Public API (with an OpenAPI spec and SDKs), a Profile API, Functions, and language libraries, but nothing mentions an official command-line tool. APIs and SDKs are developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
